obligations.summary: A notified body that subcontracts conformity assessment tasks or uses a subsidiary must ensure the subcontractor or subsidiary meets the requirements of Article 31 and must inform the notifying authority accordingly.
Notified bodies must take full responsibility for all tasks performed by their subcontractors or subsidiaries.
Subcontracting or use of a subsidiary for conformity assessment activities may only occur with the prior agreement of the provider.
Notified bodies must make a publicly available list of all their subsidiaries.

Notified bodies must retain documents concerning the qualification assessment of subcontractors or subsidiaries and work carried out by them and keep these at the disposal of the notifying authority for five years from the termination date of the subcontracting.
